Bucket C shipped (all opus-verified; codex quota-blocked until Jul 24):
- cc-interact v0.11.1 (ae05d3e): C1 — 15s re-auth watchdog on tokenless SSE streams, closes on trust revocation; loopback/bearer untouched.
- synckit v0.19.0 (4f47769): C6 — 10s overall ssh dial budget (skip-to-canonical). Documented as correct-by-design (opus-confirmed, not rubber-stamped): 255-only failover (wrong host → host-key failure → 255) and caller-owns-command-deadlines.
- cc-orchestrate 6b2799d: C2 documented (launcher MUST exec, not fork — exec-vs-fork not runtime-detectable; prober corroboration rejected as leaky), C3 fixed (partial UNIQUE index on session_id + restore validation).
- cc-runtime 78b9f10 + dc01baf: C5 fixed (per-sender mutex serializes the subscription-cap check→append→project; opus reproduced the defect by neutralizing the mutex), C4 documented ((session,scope) is the durable subject key; pid-in-key would break resume-reconnect via cc-interact's Rebind CAS — invariant documented instead). Bumped cc-interact v0.11.1 + synckit v0.19.0 (cross-minor additive; SSE re-auth arrives without wiring).
- cc-present 23555d2: bumped to cc-interact v0.11.1 (shared tokenless surface gets SSE re-auth).

C7 (push content carries prompt text → Apple/lock screen) kept as-is by user decision — documented as accepted by-design.

Process note: my opus-fallback guard in the wave-2 workflow (verdict.clean===undefined) missed a codex-wrapper returning a STRUCTURED quota-block verdict (clean:false + blocker finding) rather than null — dispatched a standalone opus verify instead. Future guard should key on the quota-error shape, not just null.

DEFERRED GATE unchanged: codex cross-model re-verification of the entire P7 fix set (Buckets A+C) at quota reset before declaring P7 fully closed.
